title: Dynamic model roles
implementation: Discover role capabilities dynamically per provider, preserving role/model/thinking semantics and confirmed settings; never impose fixed OMP roles on other providers.
acceptance: Role candidates reflect the selected provider/model; partial failures keep confirmed values; Profile and native preset flows reuse typed dynamic data without a second store. Generic UI never parses OMP strings, aliases or thinking suffixes; provider adapters own that interpretation.

interface_disclosure.modelRoleFeatureKeys: feature_values["modelRole.<id>"] = "native" | "unset" | "<selector>[:<effort>]"; existing opaque ConfigPatch map, no new store or protocol method
interface_disclosure.roleFeatures: Role selects ride the existing AgentFeatureSelect DTO as ordinary options with adapter-computed metadata {nativeSelector, resolvedSelector}; generic UI parses no OMP strings
interface_disclosure.reopenLifecycle: A role-assignment change joins the task05 atomic reconnect trigger set: same identity and confinement, private AIT-owned --config temp file, resume persisted sessionFile, verify sessionId unchanged
interface_disclosure.downgrade: Old hosts return no role features, so clients fall back to stored/absent values without parsing; old clients render role selects as plain selects and never see OMP-only vocabulary

implementation_completed: local/omp/roles.rs: discovery union, bounded validation, feature rendering, stored-key fallback, private overlay materialization, overlay equivalence, alias resolution

local/omp.rs: identity-keyed role catalog cache (serialized per key, LRU 32, stale-identity fence, last-good retention), draft_features/discover/settings role projection, snapshot-refresh invalidation
